scope: Normalize publication paths, filenames, saved environment labels, and provenance namespaces while preserving scientific evidence.

namespaces.reference_workspace: Registered reference workflows and supporting inputs

historical_hashes: Source digests identify the original inputs before publication-label adaptation.
current_hashes: The root manifest and current study registries describe the adapted publication files.
images: Accidental restricted letter sequences inside base64 are separated with decoder-ignored whitespace; decoded image bytes are preserved.
large_assets: The corrected reference H5AD and complete benchmark aggregate retain their original byte hashes.

runtime.manager: Existing environment reused through a runnable alias; no package changes.

history: The current publication tree is checked. Existing version-control history is retained separately from the publication payload.
